tasks.title: HOUR() of a DATETIME with date zero occasionally (unpredictably) returns NULL

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 完整三种等价HOUR计算可检验一致性；已称5.6以后不复现，目标仅回归探索。

test_spec.steps: 对列、派生CAST和直接CAST分别调用HOUR。
test_spec.oracle: 合法入库同一值的HOUR结果应一致；零日期被拒则记不适用而非bug。
test_spec.target_applicability: 8.0支持HOUR；需原零日期模式，未假定仍受影响。
